title: Duel Defense: how to play
sections: Tanks and mechs drive along the road to your base. Destroy them before they get there: every enemy that reaches your base takes away base health. Survive all the waves of a map to win. You earn 1 to 5 stars, one for every 20% of base health you have left.
Tap Play (bottom right) to start the first wave; after that a new wave comes every few seconds on its own. Play also pauses and resumes, and >> speeds the game up.
Tap a turret at the bottom, then drag it to a free spot beside the road and lift your finger to build it there (red means you can't build there). Destroyed enemies pay money for more turrets.

Gun (200): a cheap, quick gun; upgrade it to a heavier Gun II and Gun III, or into a Laser. Laser (400): a beam that keeps burning its target; it upgrades too. Missile (500): slow but hits hard from far away. Bomb (300) and Jet (500) are one-off attacks you can drop anywhere.
Tap a built turret to see its options: upgrade it (the price is on the button), repair it, or sell it to get money back.
Build near bends in the road, where turrets can hit enemies for longer. Upgrading is often better value than buying many weak guns. Keep some money for a Bomb when a big wave comes.
